map.如何使用多段文本合并？: How do I use Multi-Text Merger?
map.输入多段文本（每行一段，或用 --- 分隔）: Enter text blocks (one per line, or separate with ---)
map.多段/多列拼接：把两个列表按行合并（如名字+邮箱成一行）。: Multi-block / multi-column join: merge two lists by row (e.g. name + email into one line).
map.文件片段连接：把分块文本拼成整体，准备发布。: File fragment join: stitch chunked text into one whole, ready to publish.
map.分隔符定制：用逗号/制表符/换行连接，产出 CSV 或表格源。: Custom separators: join with comma / tab / newline to produce CSV or table sources.
map.名字与邮箱按行合并: Merge names and emails by row
map.第一段内容\n第二段内容\n第三段内容\n第四段内容:
First paragraph
Second paragraph
Third paragraph
Fourth paragraph
map.将多段分散文本按行或自定义分隔符合并为一段，可去空行与去重，适用于整理笔记、拼接: Merge scattered text blocks into one by line or custom separator, dropping blank lines and duplicates; for tidying notes, stitching logs and batch text restructuring; processed locally, nothing leaves your browser.
map.输入三行「苹果 / 香蕉 / 橙子」，分隔符选顿号并勾选跳过空行，结果为「苹果、: Enter three lines "apple / banana / orange", choose the ideographic comma separator and skip blank lines to get "apple、banana、orange"; ticking "Add numbering" gives "1. apple、2. banana、3. orange". This tool joins lines horizontally and does not pair two columns.
map.输出结果会覆盖上一次结果吗？: Does the output overwrite the previous result?
map.结果区每次按当前输入与选项重新生成并覆盖上一次结果；原始文本始终保留在输入框，可: The result area is regenerated from the current input and options each time, overwriting the previous result; the source text stays in the input box so you can adjust the rules and retry.
map.不会。合并在浏览器本地完成字符串拼接，输入内容与结果都不会发送到服务器。: No. Merging is plain string concatenation in your browser; neither the input nor the result is sent to a server.
map.内容本身含分隔符要紧吗？: Does it matter if the content itself contains the separator?
map.本工具不做 CSV 转义：若结果要作为 CSV 字段，内容本身含逗号时请改用制表: This tool does not perform CSV escaping: if the output is used as a CSV field and the content contains commas, switch to a tab or a custom separator, otherwise the columns will split.
